reason: I already built my whole system in Notion with databases and templates, and it works on my phone and laptop. I might poke at the free tier, but I'm not paying $6 a month on a $3,000 income to rebuild what I already have.
objection: Nothing here says who can see my notes and data or whether I can export everything if I leave. An assistant reading my whiteboard photos and purchases, with no word on export, sounds like a lock-in trap.
would_change_my_mind: A clear privacy policy plus one-click full export (CSV or Markdown) and a Notion import that keeps my databases, so switching costs me nothing.
